in_sanskrit.name: महाक्षी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahat (great) + Kshi (eye, sight) = Mahakshi (Great Eye, All-Seeing)

in_hindi.name: महाक्षी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Mahat (बड़ा, big) + Kshi (अँख, eye) = Mahakshi (बड़ी अँखों, Big Eyes)

in_tamil.name: மகாக்ஷி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Makam (போர், great) + Akshi (விளக்கு, eye) = Mahakshi (போர் விளக்கு, Great Eye)

in_telugu.name: మీధేశి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mee (మీద్య, great) + Hesham (హేశము, eye) = Mahakshi (మీధేశి, Great Eye)

in_marathi.name: Mahakshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahakshi is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Great Goddess'. This name is revered in Hindu mythology as a manifestation of the divine feminine, representing power, strength, and wisdom.
